description: Official places to find an apprenticeship or official information about apprenticeships, per country. Curated and checked by hand; links verified on 2026-10-17.

links.title: Find an apprenticeship place (AMS/WKO Lehrstellenbörse)
links.publisher: Public Employment Service Austria (AMS) with the Austrian Economic Chambers (WKO)
links.note: Joint AMS/WKO apprenticeship vacancy exchange; the page links to the search in the AMS eJob-Room.

links.title: Apprenticeship information (WKO Lehre)
links.publisher: Austrian Economic Chambers (WKO)

links.title: Erasmus+ vocational education and training (OeAD)
links.publisher: OeAD – Austria's Agency for Education and Internationalisation (Erasmus+ national agency)

links.title: Dual learning in Flanders (Duaal Leren)
links.publisher: Flemish Government

links.title: Work-linked training in French-speaking Belgium (OFFA)
links.publisher: OFFA – Office francophone de la formation en alternance

BE.note: No single national vacancy search: training is organised by community/region (Flanders, Wallonia–Brussels, German-speaking Community).

links.title: National Agency for Vocational Education and Training (NAVET)
links.publisher: National Agency for Vocational Education and Training (NAVET)
links.note: National VET agency: list of VET professions, licensed training centres and rules for work-based (dual) learning; mainly institutional.

links.title: Erasmus+ vocational education and training (HRDC)
links.publisher: Human Resource Development Centre (Erasmus+ National Agency)

BG.note: No official search service for dual-learning places found. Checked Employment Agency (az.government.bg), Ministry of Education (mon.bg, Cloudflare-blocked) and dual.mon.bg (an ESF project site that ended in 2023, left out).

links.title: Find an apprenticeship place in a licensed craft workshop
links.publisher: Croatian Chamber of Trades and Crafts (HOK)
links.note: Search licensed workshops by occupation, county and place; a place must be secured before enrolling in a crafts programme.

links.title: Vocational education for crafts (JMO apprenticeship)
links.publisher: Croatian Chamber of Trades and Crafts (HOK)

links.title: Erasmus+ vocational education and training
links.publisher: Agency for Mobility and EU Programmes (AMPEU)

links.title: Apprenticeship System (SMEEK): general information
links.publisher: Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth – Directorate of Secondary Technical and Vocational Education and Training
links.note: Covers Preparatory Apprenticeship and the Core Apprenticeship; sibling pages give registrations and schools by district.

links.title: Erasmus+ National Agency (IDEP)
links.publisher: Foundation for the Management of European Lifelong Learning Programmes (IDEP)
links.note: Agency homepage; no separate VET landing page.

CY.note: No public vacancy service for apprenticeship places found; enrolment is through the technical schools.

links.title: Infoabsolvent: vocational schools, fields of study and occupations
links.publisher: National Pedagogical Institute of the Czech Republic (NPI ČR)

links.title: Erasmus+ for VET pupils and students
links.publisher: Czech National Agency for International Education and Research (DZS)

CZ.note: No official search for dual practical-training places found (dual training is arranged by schools; the new certified 'duální praktické vyučování' started in 2026).

links.title: Find an apprenticeship place (Lærepladsen.dk)
links.publisher: Danish Agency for IT and Learning (STIL), Ministry of Education
links.note: Formerly praktikpladsen.dk (permanent redirect). Site sits behind a STIL bot check that blocks scripted requests.

links.title: Job Market Finland: open vacancies (search 'oppisopimus')
links.publisher: Job Market Finland (KEHA Centre / public employment services)
links.note: No dedicated apprenticeship search; apprenticeship jobs appear in the national job market and can be found with the keyword 'oppisopimus'.

links.publisher: State Scholarships Foundation (IKY), Erasmus+ National Agency

links.title: Erasmus+ vocational education and training

RO.note: No apprenticeship-specific vacancy search found; ANOFM's general vacancy list and county agencies handle apprenticeship placements. Dual VET places are offered through schools and county school inspectorates.

links.title: Dual vocational training (FP Dual, general and intensive)

ES.note: No national search for intensive (dual) FP places found; places are arranged by regional education authorities and FP schools. The SEPIE Erasmus+ site was left out: its HTTPS certificate had expired when checked.

links.title: Erasmus+ for vocational education
links.publisher: Swedish Council for Higher Education (UHR)

NO.note: Applications for apprenticeship places go through the counties via vigo.no. vilbli.no (the counties' upper secondary portal) blocks automated checks with a captcha and was not included.

links.note: Same register in French at orientation.ch and Italian at orientamento.ch.

links.publisher: Careers Wales (Welsh Government Apprenticeship Vacancy Service)

UK.note: Apprenticeships are devolved. Northern Ireland: nidirect 'Search for apprenticeship opportunities' (https://www.nidirect.gov.uk/services/search-apprenticeship-opportunities, checked 200).

links.title: Vocational schools, training courses and employment programmes (AKPA)
links.publisher: National Agency for Employment and Skills (AKPA)
links.note: The national agency for public VET providers and the employment service; not an apprenticeship search.

AL.note: No official apprenticeship vacancy service found. AKPA's employment-promotion programmes (VKM 17/2020) include on-the-job training and internships, but these are applied for by employers through e-Albania. The aftesi.puna.gov.al VET portal is a script-only app, so its content could not be checked.

BA.note: No state-level apprenticeship or dual-VET portal found. Education is run by Republika Srpska, the ten Federation cantons and Brčko District, and dual VET exists only in local pilots and draft laws (e.g. Sarajevo Canton).

links.title: Vocational education portal: programmes and registration (vet.ge)
links.publisher: Education Management Information System (EMIS), Ministry of Education, Science and Youth of Georgia
links.note: Official VET portal with programmes, institutions, admission conditions and twice-yearly registration, including dual-approach programmes.

MD.note: No official dual-VET search or learner portal found. Checked the Ministry of Education and Research VET section (mec.gov.md, navigation only, no dual-education content), the eadmitere.gov.md admissions platform (script-only, content could not be checked) and ANOFM.

ME.note: No official dual-VET portal could be checked. The VET Centre (cso.edu.me) returned 503, the Employment Agency (zzzcg.me) and the Chamber of Economy (privrednakomora.me) did not respond, and no gov.me page on dual education was found.

links.title: Work-based learning portal (Praksa)
links.publisher: Economic Chamber of North Macedonia
links.note: Information on work-based learning and dual VET, and the list of verified employers offering practical training. Not a vacancy search.

links.title: Erasmus+ Key Action 1: mobility for VET learners and staff
links.publisher: National Agency for European Educational Programmes and Mobility

MK.note: The VET Centre site (csoo.edu.mk) is behind a Cloudflare challenge and was not used.

links.title: Dual education in Serbia: information for students and employers
links.publisher: Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Serbia (PKS)
links.note: PKS accredits dual-education companies and runs employer registration through this portal (contact obrazovanje@pks.rs).

links.title: Erasmus+ vocational education and training
links.publisher: Tempus Foundation (Erasmus+ National Agency, Serbia)

links.title: Vocational Education Centres (MESEM): apprenticeship and journeyman training
links.publisher: Ministry of National Education (MEB), Directorate General for Vocational and Technical Education
links.note: Covers enrolment conditions, the 1 day at school / 4 days in a company pattern, pay and certificates. Learners enrol at a MESEM or vocational high school.

links.title: Erasmus+ opportunities for learners, including VET traineeships abroad
links.publisher: Turkish National Agency (Centre for EU Education and Youth Programmes)

TR.note: No official national search for apprenticeship (MESEM) places found.

links.title: Dual education in vocational education
links.publisher: Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine
links.note: The ministry site blocks scripts with a Cloudflare challenge (403). The page is confirmed by search results, and some of its content (statistics) is from 2020/21.

UA.note: No official search for dual-education places found.

links.title: Agency for Vocational Education and Training and Adult Education (AAAPARR)
links.publisher: Agency for VET and Adult Education, established by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology
links.note: The national VET agency, which runs the six Competence Centres. Its pages are institutional, not a learner guide to apprenticeships.

XK.note: No official apprenticeship or work-based learning search found. Dual VET is still being piloted with donor support.
